job: Open the full navigation as a sheet on a phone.
purpose: On phones the menu button opens a full-height sheet under the top bar: the upgrade first, then the account, then every destination with its icon on the right. Between 640 and 900px it is a side sheet over a scrim. It traps focus, locks page scroll and closes on Escape.
useWhen: The sidebar is hidden below 900px and people still need every destination.
The shell needs the upgrade and the account in reach on a phone.

avoidWhen.when: The same nav on a desktop width.
A short list of actions anchored to a button.
A bottom sheet with other content.

variants.useWhen: A child item under a group, indented.
Show a part only on the phone side of 900px.
Show a part only on the desktop side of 900px.

parts.role: The sheet; trigger it with data-fd-mobile-nav and aria-controls.
The upgrade buttons at the top.

keyboard.does: Closes the sheet and returns focus to the menu button.
Cycles inside the sheet while it is open.
